column1: # The playout lines the Companion module sends, held to Stagewatch's own grammar from both ends. The module's tests press each
# action with its options and expect exactly the line (test/module.test.mjs); Stagewatch's suite reads each line as its Companion
# server does — tokenized, then ShowCommandParser — and expects the kind, the packed arguments (U+0001 shown as |) and the number
# (CompanionV2Tests). A name row says whether a word may name a playout link: the module's playoutLinkName and Stagewatch's
# PlayoutRules.NameProblem agree on every row, and every action word, trust and reserved name Stagewatch knows has a row. A refuse
# row is a press the module answers in its log with those first words, sending nothing.
